title: KissFM - Disturbed - The Sound of Silence [CYRIL Remix]

lines.l: A street lamp, I turned my collar to the cold and damp
When my eyes were stemmed by the flash of a neon light
That split the night and touched the sound of silence
And in the naked light I saw
Fools and I you do not know
Hear my words and I'm a high teacher
Play my arms and I'm behind me too
And the people bowed and prayed
To the neon god they made
And the sign flashed out in his warning
Hear the words that it was forming
In the science and the words of the prophets
Are written on the subway walls
And in the naked light I saw
People writing songs that voices never share
And no one dare disturb the sound of silence
